note: Updated by the Oracle weekday reviewing routine (tools/oracle/ROUTINE.md). Compared against tools/oracle/data/state.json, guidance.json and market_reference.json to decide whether a day is material. investor.oracle.com/rss/pressrelease.aspx answers HTTP 403 (Cloudflare challenge) to curl, Invoke-WebRequest and node fetch; the same feed is readable as JSON at investor.oracle.com/feed/PressRelease.svc/GetPressReleaseList?LanguageId=1&pageSize=20&pageNumber=0&year=2026 — the routine uses that endpoint as the fallback. As of 2026-09-24 that short query returns an empty list; the full query works: GetPressReleaseList?LanguageId=1&bodyType=0&pressReleaseDateFilter=3&categoryId=1cb807d2-208f-4bc3-9133-6a9ad45ac3b0&pageSize=20&pageNumber=0&tagList=&includeTags=true&year=2026&excludeSelection=1.
